attempts.bug_summary: On decryptor reuse, footer-key metadata is only compared when no footer key is currently stored. This allows reuse with different metadata after an explicit or previously retrieved footer key has made the metadata unnecessary for key retrieval.

AAD-prefix verification is skipped when the algorithm requires an externally supplied prefix and the file does not contain one. This allows initialization to succeed with a configured verifier even though there is no file prefix for it to validate.

The reuse check compares the algorithm objects by identity rather than by value. Consequently, a separately constructed algorithm carrying equivalent metadata is incorrectly rejected during decryptor reuse.
